name: Huawei Cloud GaussDB(DWS)
summary: Run queries and load Parquet partitions into GaussDB(DWS), the Huawei Cloud data warehouse, over its PostgreSQL-derived protocol. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision.

settings.name: endpoint
settings.label: Cluster endpoint
settings.help: The access address of the cluster from the console, without the port.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Database port
settings.help: Set when the cluster is created; Huawei's documentation uses 8000 in its examples.

egress.note: The database port is chosen when the cluster is created. 8000 is the value in Huawei's examples; set the port setting to your cluster's.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query and keep the result as Parquet.
Load Parquet rows into a table through SQL, once per partition and revision.

notes: DWS can also read files in Huawei OBS through foreign tables (see the Huawei OBS connector). Ogun does not create the table.
